parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL1936. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens', join assays to target_dictionary on tid, filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936', join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, left join compound_structures on molregno. Return distinct compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
